name: Settings Manager
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Manage Omarchy shell plugins and your desktop settings in one window, laid out like a settings app: Plugins, Bar layout with drag and drop, Updates, Maprisma apps, System apps, Network, Bluetooth, Appearance, Theme, Displays, Sound, Notifications, AI, Voice, Power, Optimize, Input devices, Applications, Time & Language and About. Admin changes only on your click, through polkit or a visible terminal.
